cases.query: Create an interactive solar system live orbit simulator as a single HTML file, dark sci-fi HUD aesthetic with a cinematic, soft-glow atmosphere. Layout: top-left title 'COSMOS — SOLAR SYSTEM LIVE ORBIT SIM' with live simulated date in '16 SEP 2026' format, UTC time and MJD value; left vertical planet nav list (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Overview) with colored dots; center 3D scene with softly glowing sun, eight textured planets, orbit lines, asteroid belt particles and starfield; top-right camera state (Free camera / Following [planet name]) and real-time FPS; bottom-center TIME WARP bar showing '1 S = 1.0 DAYS' with play/pause, speed presets REAL, 1 D/S, 1 H/S, 1 M/S, 1 Y/S, NOW, and a draggable slider for smoothly adjusting time acceleration; bottom-left hint 'DRAG ORBIT, SCROLL ZOOM, CLICK A PLANET TO INSPECT & FOLLOW' — important: this hint must stay fully visible and never be covered by the TIME WARP bar (raise it above the bar or narrow the bar). Clicking a planet directly in the 3D scene (raycasting must work, not only the list) selects and follows it and opens a right-side info panel with planet type, description, radius, gravity, day length, year length, temperature, moon count and a FOCUS CAMERA button. Drag to rotate view, scroll to zoom.

cases.query: spark ignites in a glass box → fire grows → wind blows it out — single-file HTML, Three.js via CDN. Bright, clear translucent glass cube with visible wall reflections/refractions and a ground reflection, wood fuel inside; particle fire with distinct flame-tongue layers morphing through five phases: IGNITION, GROWTH, STEADY BURN, WIND, AFTERMATH — each phase shows a large serif title with a poetic subtitle. Top-right live telemetry HUD (FLAME/AIR/CORE/RENDER + fps; RENDER must report real draw calls and triangle counts, not a constant). Bottom draggable timeline scrubber for the five phases. cases.query:
Build a highly detailed 3D model of the SpaceX Starship in Three.js. Make it look like a professional aerospace product visualization with realistic metallic materials, heat shield tiles, fins, engines, windows, and fine surface details. Add a clean studio environment with realistic lighting, shadows, reflections, and subtle ambient illumination.

The default camera view must frame the entire Starship from engine nozzles to nose cone, fully visible and centered in the viewport. Heat shield tiles should only cover the windward side (roughly half the body), while the rest of the hull is polished stainless steel with mirror-like reflections and strong metallic highlights. Fins should be thick with visible root hinge details.

Allow the user to rotate, zoom, and inspect the Starship from all angles. Add a simple technical information panel displaying height, diameter, number of engines, and payload capacity. Include interactive buttons for Rotate, Turntable, and Reset View.

The final result should feel like a premium interactive 3D aerospace showcase, with polished UI, smooth camera transitions, realistic materials, and high-quality rendering.

Write all code as part of one single HTML file.

cases.query:
做一个单文件 HTML 的 3D 飞行游戏，用 Three.js。我想开一架 1903 年莱特兄弟那种双翼飞机，在一片低多边形风格的日本森林上空飞。场景里要有层叠的山、很多针叶树、红色的鸟居、日式小房子和石灯笼。天空是粉紫色渐变的，带点雾气，空气里飘着橙黄色的落叶，还有一些蓝白色的发光灵魂光点可以收集。

开始界面叫 'Forest Wind'，配个日文 '森の風'，一个红色印章风格的 '飛' 字按钮写着 'Take flight'。游戏里左下角显示空速、地速、高度，右上角显示收集的灵魂光点数量、穿过的鸟居数量和飞行距离。

飞行要有物理感：爬升会掉速度，掉太快会失速下坠，俯冲能加速回来。方向键或 WASD 控制俯仰和滚转，Shift 呼叫风加速，Ctrl 减速，Space 改平。整体氛围要宁静空灵，低多边形加水彩感，色调粉紫、灰绿、暖橙为主。

蓄力发射系统：游戏开始或球掉落後，玩家需按住鼠标左键（或触屏长按）进行蓄力，屏幕下方会显示动态力度条（有颜色渐变反馈），松开发射小球。这让每次开局都有操作手感，而非简单的点击就绪。

cases.query:
帮我做两个单文件 HTML 应用，放在当前目录，双击就能跑，不依赖外部框架、图片和 API。

第一个是手机模拟器：左边操作说明面板，右边一台虚拟手机，能上滑解锁、显示真实时间日期、打开计算器/备忘录/天气/地图/时钟/相册这些应用，下拉出通知中心，还能模拟来电接听挂断。参考 inputs/ 里的图片风格。

第二个是上海滩大富翁：支持 2-4 名玩家（人类或电脑），能选初始资金，棋盘围绕外滩、静安寺、武康路、新天地、淮海路、田子坊、豫园这些地标，中间是黄浦江。要有掷骰子、买房产、机会卡、命运卡、地铁传送，动画和本地音效都要有，右边显示玩家资产和事件记录。

两个都要视觉统一、配色精致，不要临时拼凑的 Demo 感觉。
